$comment: The ZPLC device link protocol (COM-019, COM-029): the one definition of the framed protocol that the ZPLC application and a device speak. tools/contract/generate_protocol.py writes the C header (firmware/lib/zplc_core/include/zplc_proto_defs.h), the TypeScript tables (packages/zplc-ide/src/runtime/link/protocol.generated.ts), the test frames both codecs run and the memory access cases the adapters and the device check (tools/contract/golden/protocol-vectors.json and firmware/lib/zplc_core/tests/zplc_proto_vectors.h) and, through tools/docs/generate_source_references.ts, the reference page. Change this file, then run `python3 tools/contract/generate_protocol.py`. A change that renumbers a message, an error or a field is a protocol change: increase `version`.
name: ZPLC device link

header.name: sync
header.doc: The two bytes 0x5A 0xA5. A stream decoder looks for them to find the start of a frame.

header.name: version
header.doc: The protocol version the sender speaks. A frame of another version is dropped and counted; its payload is never read.

header.name: flags
header.doc: Bits 0 and 1: the kind of the frame. Bit 2: a message authentication code follows the payload. Bits 3 to 7 are zero.

header.name: message
header.doc: The message number (a request and its response carry the same number).

header.name: sequence
header.doc: A request carries the sequence number of the sender; its response repeats it. An event carries the device's own event counter. Inside an authenticated session the sequence is covered by the code and must follow the one before it by exactly one.

kinds.name: REQUEST
kinds.doc: The ZPLC application asks the device to do something.

kinds.name: RESPONSE
kinds.doc: The device answers one request, with the same message number and sequence.

kinds.name: EVENT
kinds.doc: The device reports something that happened, without being asked.

frame.macCovers: Every byte of the frame before the code: the header and the payload.
frame.crcCovers: Every byte of the frame before the checksum: the header, the payload and the code when there is one. CRC-32/ISO-HDLC, the CRC of the artifact container.
frame.resync: A decoder that reads a stream keeps the bytes of the frame it is assembling. When the header is not valid (sync, version, reserved bits, length above its limit) or the checksum does not match, it discards the first byte of that candidate, looks for the next sync pair among the bytes it already holds, and goes on from there. A frame that was hidden inside the bytes of a damaged one is therefore delivered, and no frame after a damaged one is lost. A transport that frames its own lines (one frame per line, in hexadecimal) hands each line to the decoder whole and needs no resynchronisation.

doc.en: The request was done.
doc.es: La solicitud se cumplió.

doc.en: The device does not know the message number.
doc.es: El dispositivo no conoce el número de mensaje.

doc.en: The payload does not have the layout of the message.
doc.es: La carga útil no tiene el formato del mensaje.

doc.en: This build does not have the capability the message needs (see the capabilities of the hello).
doc.es: Esta compilación no tiene la capacidad que el mensaje necesita (véanse las capacidades del saludo).

doc.en: The message needs a session that is open on this link.
doc.es: El mensaje necesita una sesión abierta en este enlace.

doc.en: A session is already open on another link.
doc.es: Ya hay una sesión abierta en otro enlace.

doc.en: A network link has no authenticated session: open one with a key that was provisioned over the serial link.
doc.es: Un enlace de red no tiene sesión autenticada: abra una con una clave que se aprovisionó por el enlace serie.

doc.en: The device holds no key, or the session could not be authenticated.
doc.es: El dispositivo no tiene clave, o no se pudo autenticar la sesión.

doc.en: The challenge of the open request was not the one the device issued last, or it expired: ask for a new one.
doc.es: El desafío de la solicitud de apertura no era el último que emitió el dispositivo, o venció: pida uno nuevo.

doc.en: The access is not inside one region of PLC memory, or the region is not writable. The response carries the requested address and length and the region that holds the address.
doc.es: El acceso no está dentro de una región de la memoria del PLC, o la región no admite escritura. La respuesta lleva la dirección y la longitud pedidas y la región que contiene la dirección.

doc.en: A queue has no room; nothing was done.
doc.es: Una cola no tiene espacio; no se hizo nada.

doc.en: The runtime is not in a state where the message applies (a program transfer while running, RUN with no program).
doc.es: El runtime no está en un estado donde el mensaje aplica (una transferencia de programa en marcha, RUN sin programa).

doc.en: A rule of the device forbids it on this link (a takeover from the network, a key over the network).
doc.es: Una regla del dispositivo lo prohíbe en este enlace (una toma de control desde la red, una clave por la red).

doc.en: The loader refused the artifact.
doc.es: El cargador rechazó el artefacto.

doc.en: The program is larger than the device accepts.
doc.es: El programa es más grande de lo que el dispositivo acepta.

doc.en: The CRC-32 of the transferred program is not the one announced.
doc.es: El CRC-32 del programa transferido no es el anunciado.

doc.en: A resource the message needs is in use; try again.
doc.es: Un recurso que el mensaje necesita está en uso; reintente.

doc.en: The device tried and could not do it.
doc.es: El dispositivo lo intentó y no pudo.

doc.en: The device holds a public key and accepts only signed programs: send the signature of the artifact before the commit.
doc.es: El dispositivo tiene una clave pública y solo acepta programas firmados: envíe la firma del artefacto antes de confirmar.

doc.en: The signature is not a signature of this artifact under the key of the device; the transfer is dropped.
doc.es: La firma no es una firma de este artefacto bajo la clave del dispositivo; se descarta la transferencia.

doc.es: Sesiones: un solo escritor a la vez, con tiempo de inactividad.

doc.es: Fijar, borrar y listar forzados; los forzados de una sesión terminan con ella.

doc.en: Authenticated sessions (HMAC-SHA-256) and key provisioning over the serial link.
